natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two inherited findings indicate that simplification improved completion, time-to-value, and durable SMB activation. This directly addresses both current symptoms while avoiding the known 30-day retention risk associated with aggressive promotional pricing. Verify the two most directly relevant records before launching a controlled experiment.
